style: apply original scoped lint and formatting to r3 repairs

Apply the original scoped Clippy change removing two redundant Linux64 casts, followed by the original formatter across 17 source paths. Preserve complete tuple assertions, security controls and original test deadlines. The full suite result remains bound to pre-hygiene tree fb9e131272f7e7a138d6c0d1af2b048b9a6ab7ff: 19490 JUnit passes, 16 failures, 57 original ignored cases and 25 observed early returns. Final source requires fresh original platform CI; no whole-candidate qualification is claimed.
